Text: Someone stole a DNA-Locked Prototype Raven Combat Armor. The thief is dead in the Underground under the market, under a Mutated Garbage Flea.
{delay 1}Garbage Fleas line that path. Bring the armor back. The Shady Guy south of the landing is a different crook.

I'm so happy I could kiss ya!
My armor! These Biological Survey Nanobots are yours.

handin_armor.Text: Let's see it, then. Put it in the trade window.{opentrade}

busy_armor.Text: The dead thief in the Underground, under the Mutated Garbage Flea.

Text: Marco sent you? Of course he did.

Well howdy, y'all. Welcome and step on up to Sarah Greene's Armor Imporium. As a new arrival you may not know that it's dangerous to go alone through the wilds of Rubi-Ka, without proper protection. Lucky for you, I've got the best custom-made protection available in the shuttleport!

anyone.Text: You should talk to Remi Gallois. He ain't such a bad guy.

sale.Text: I offer several types of armor, some which aren't too common, and some which you won't find anywhere else. Come check out my wares.  <font color="#ff0000">Press the Shopping Cart icon towards the bottom of the chat window to engage trade with Sarah.</font>
